The company is planning to acquire Hugging Face, a New York-based startup which has built a repository for open source AI models and recently shot to global recognition after it came under a cyberattack by rogue OpenAI models. Half of Nvidia's business, Huang said, is "really largely driven by open models." The chip giant itself is a big developer of open models — with Huang telling CNBC on Thursday that the company was the largest contributor of open models in the world "by far.". One of the learnings from that transaction was that allowing a tech giant to acquire an "important repository puts everybody else at a disadvantage," Luria added, making Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face a "defensive move".

The company is planning to acquire Hugging Face, a New York-based startup which has built a repository for open source AI models and recently shot to global recognition after it came under a cyberattack by rogue OpenAI models. Half of Nvidia's business, Huang said, is "really largely driven by open models." The chip giant itself is a big developer of open models — with Huang telling CNBC on Thursday that the company was the largest contributor of open models in the world "by far.". highlights: # Why Nvidia's 'defensive move' to acquire Hugging Face is about much more than chips. * Nvidia’s $12.9 billion deal for Hugging Face puts it closer to millions of AI developers and one of the industry’s most important open-model platforms. The company is planning to acquire Hugging Face, a New York-based startup which has built a repository for open source AI models and recently shot to global recognition after it came under a cyberattack by rogue OpenAI models. Half of Nvidia's business, Huang said, is "really largely driven by open models." The chip giant itself is a big developer of open models — with Huang telling CNBC on Thursday that the company was the largest contributor of open models in the world "by far.". One of the learnings from that transaction was that allowing a tech giant to acquire an "important repository puts everybody else at a disadvantage," Luria added, making Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face a "defensive move".
